methods.SSD_throughput: Sum over all blocks: overlap([ssd_start_ms,ssd_end_ms),[2000,4000)) * 40 / 2000. Unit GiB/s. Clip partial blocks.
methods.SSU_utilization: Total physical SSD throughput / 120. Equivalently sum per-disk busy ms / (3*2000).
methods.demand: Read original piecewise CSV, sum(rate * segment_duration) / 2000.
methods.conditional_throughput: Intersect SSD busy intervals with CSV segments satisfying demand >120 (or <=120), sum per-disk busy durations *40 / sum selected segment durations. No temporal bins.
methods.blue: Original summed per-card layer-period-average NPU receive rates. Window integral matches physical link overlap integral at 50 GiB/s.
methods.all_idle: Complement of union of all three disks physical service intervals; intersect exactly with demand segments for overloaded-idle duration.
methods.scope: Baseline seed7 random/ordered only; request-arrival work is finite, all NPUs have admitted work throughout this window.
